issue.title: Legacy Git batch readers can deadlock before stdout draining
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1m3.4.1.2 note 1. At sase-core be2bfbee, file_history/blobs.rs read_blobs writes all requested OIDs synchronously before reading cat-file stdout; memory_history/causes.rs batched_diff_tree writes all commit IDs before wait_with_output. Neither file changed during the epic. Migrate both to the new concurrent run_git_unchecked_with_stdin helper, preserving protocol parsing, missing and oversize blob behavior, framing, timeouts, output caps, explicit truncation handling, and child cleanup. Existing tests plus over-pipe input/output and timeout regressions should pass. Medium: precise shared root cause, two known call sites, existing bounded helper; no architecture or new API is needed. Semantic task searches across all statuses and the last-week task sweep found no duplicate; in-progress epic sweep found no causal owner, and sase-1m3 explicitly deferred these pre-existing callers.

task_type_fields.impact: Large file-history and memory-history batches can hang past their advertised timeouts; these custom spawn paths also miss the shared runner environment hardening.
task_type_fields.repro: Independent landing reproduction on 2026-10-17: hermetic temporary Git repo; write a 131072-byte blob and a root commit with a 200-character path. Send 20000 repeated blob IDs to cat-file --batch or commit IDs to diff-tree --stdin --root -r --name-only -z, writing and flushing each ID before starting any stdout read, as both functions do. A writer checks a 100ms deadline only before each write. After 750ms both remained blocked with Git alive (1683 and 1881 writes respectively); killing and reaping Git unblocked each writer. This reproduces the protocol and IO ordering directly, not a Rust test invocation.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1m3.4.1.2 explicitly deferred migrating the two legacy batch readers. Landing independently reproduced their write-before-read pipe deadlock; it predates this epic and remains outside the project_stats core scope.

payload.description: Phase note 1 explicitly proposed the legacy batch migration; landing independently reproduced the pre-existing deadlock
